proposals.evidence: Turner’s second *lakkuṭa branch explicitly includes Awankari lukṛī, Lahnda/Punjabi lakkaṛ, Hindi lakṛī, Gujarati lākṛũ and Marathi lākaḍ wood/firewood. These retained-k survey forms match the regional branch; Pothwari lūkrī also matches Turner’s specific Awankari vowel form.
